criteria.requirement: Add python -m liquid.project_cli and callable main(argv) using real Environment/FileSystemLoader/StrictUndefined, explicit --root --template --data --output. Require object JSON, local root-contained nonabsolute/non-parent-traversing template and root-contained resolved source; output cannot replace input JSON or any template-root file. Render completely before creating same-output-directory temp file, flush/fsync and os.replace atomically; cleanup on failure preserves existing output and prints only safe error type with exit2. Unicode, include/render, empty output and actual saved file must work. No network or credential lookup, no environment-data guessing, no source/config/test changes.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
